## Agarican, Psibyl (CR 15)

**XP** 51,200  
LN Medium plant (fungus)  
**Init** +9; **Senses** low-light vision, thoughtsense 60 ft.; Perception +31  


**Defense**


**AC** 31, touch 15, flat-footed 26 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +16 natural)  
**hp** 209 (22d8+110)  
**Fort** +18, Ref +13, Will +13; **Immune** plant traits; **Resist** fire 10, electricity 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 30 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** 10 tentacles +19 (1d6+2 plus poison)  
**Psychic Magic** (CL 15th; concentration +21)  


27 PE—ectoplasmic snare (3 PE, DC 18), ghost whip (2 PE), hypercognition (2 PE), mindlink (1 PE), mind probe (4 PE, DC 19), telekinetic storm (9 PE, DC 24), withdraw affliction (6 PE)  


**Spell-like Abilities** (CL 15th; concentration +21)  


Constant—speak with plants, greensight  

At will—burst of nettles (DC 18), dust of twilight (DC 17), entangle (DC 16), fungal infestation (DC 18), pernicious poison (DC 17), spore burst (DC 18), telekinesis (DC 20)  

3/day—control plants (DC 24), prismatic glow (DC 21), vine strike (DC 18)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 15, **Dex** 20, **Con** 20, **Int** 21, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +18, **CMD** 34  
**Feats** Combat Casting, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Iron Will, Improved Initiative, Lunge, Spell Focus (Enchantment), Spring Attack, Verdant Spell, [Weapon Focus (tentacle)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Weapon Focus (tentacle).*  
**Skills** Bluff +24, Intimidate +24, Knowledge (dungeoneering, geography, nature) +27, Perception +31, Sense Motive +28  
Languages Agaric, Aklo, Common, Sylvan, Terran, Undercommon; telepathy 100 ft.  
**SQ** compression  


**Special Abilities**


**Luminescent Lamella (Ex)** The glowing markings and tendrils of a psibyl constantly emit a soft light, equivalent to that of a candle. This light brightens to the equivalent of a torch when they are using any of their spell-like abilities or psychic magic, or the sending or witness functions of their psychic spores ability.  

**Poison (Ex)** Tentacle—injury; *save* Fort DC 21; *frequency* 1/round for 4 rounds; *effect* 1d3 Wis & 1 Int; *cure* 1 save. Save DC is Con-based.  

**Psychic Spores (Su)** A creature coming within 30 feet of a psibyl must make a DC 23 Fortitude save every round they remain within range or be infected by an inhaled form of their spores. A psibyl can sense the direction of any creature infected with their psychic spores, and if the creature is within 1 mile they can sense its precise location. As a standard action, a psibyl may cast sending, targeting any creature it has infected with its psychic spores, though the infected creature may choose to make a new saving throw against the psychic spores instead of responding to the sending.
